text.description_html:
Acorn RHBBQ, 4-1/2" Rough Iron H Hinge

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths. The 4-1/2 Inch Rough Iron H Hinge are forged with this in mind. For interior and exterior doors, the rough iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered iron. It has a lifetime no rust warranty.

Specifications of the 4-1/2" Rough Black Iron Hinge:

  • Suitable as heavy cabinet hinges or for use on light interior doors.
  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Overall Width: 1-3/4"
  • Hinge Leaf Width: 5/8"

Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Priced and sold as a pair. (2-hinges).
